column4: Car times versions raised by one for the released cars; the 22B stays a test car.
Mustang GT3 and Mercedes 190E are no longer test cars.

New graphics release.
- Audi RS6 released
- Contributors section in About
- Main menu cars grouped AWD, FWD, RWD
- Foliage and rendering improvements by hyphyphyph
Vodno, Galichica West and Peugeot 206 released.\n- New stage order: Ajvatovci, Petralica, Vodno, Galichica West, Jackie\n- Stage cards show badges and best time at the bottom
- Subaru WRX STI released\n- Vodno stage times version 2 (new temperatures and trees)\n- About: NPC cars section with background car and truck credits

- Stage Board menu and HUD look
- Front and tail lamps, background cars and people
- Building textures, Vodno trees, new sky and colour grade
- Season and time of day on stage times, faster loading

- Fiat 126p and Subaru 22B released
- Bloom off and ambient occlusion on by default
- Ground textures, new grass and far shadows
- Forested far mountains
Performance tuning.\n- Fewer frame spikes while driving, faster loads\n- Faster tree loading, no freeze on the first steer
Version label update.
- Faster tree rendering\n- Real far trees on slopes\n- Render scale option

Roadside props and scenery closer to real.
- New rocks, hay bales, delineators, barriers and chevron signs
- Green spring grass on Vodno and Galichica
- Gravel spray as tumbling stones, water ripples

Rendering performance.
- Fewer slow frames and stalls on every stage
- Fewer draw calls on forest stages
- Auto render scale option
Trees V3.\n- New crown colour and shading, impostors, branches, bark and wind\n- Portal tagline and README note on playtesting

Tires, replays and fixes.
- Realistic tyres with tread, sidewall lettering and dust
- Record runs and watch replays
- Updated README and docs
First release: Kaboom is available in the game menu.

Mid-poly art pass.
- Filmic light, painted parts and bevels
- Clearer team rings, hats and camera angle
- New blocks, crates and story props per level
- Plank chunks, stone chips, hit-stop and smoke
New textured dynamite and power-up graphics.
The Boom Crew gets a new cartoon look: seamless bodies, a shared rig with new poses, and toon paint.
Release build.
Smaller Toy Emporium: 220 x 160 m floor, 9 000 points, hole capped at level 15. Toy Emporium scoring version 9.
Release build.
